title: Project Management Platform Incident Response
description: Project management platform incidents affecting construction operations
immediate_actions: Assess impact on construction project management and coordination
Implement manual project tracking procedures if needed
Contact project managers for critical project needs
investigation_steps: Review project management platform logs and status
Verify network connectivity to platform systems
resolution_steps: Restart project management services following standard procedures
Implement database fixes or restart if needed
Apply platform patches or configuration changes
Coordinate with platform vendor for complex issues
verification: Confirm with project managers that system is operational
special_considerations: Project management is critical for construction project coordination
Manual procedures may impact project efficiency
Coordinate with project managers for critical project needs
Document any platform interruptions that may affect project timelines
